The bank’s co-president says markets are about two-to-three years away from the end of the economic cycle. Expect markets to be nervous about anything that relations to inflation or growth. The chart 
To mark International Women’s Day, the Economist is taking a look at the gender gap among the rich. Its chart shows the number of female billionaires in the world, compared with male. 
It should come as little surprise to see who’s on top:

“We don’t believe in these tariffs.” — That was JPMorgan Chase chief Jamie Dimon, in comments to Bloomberg Thursday .

Former Uber CEO Travis Kalanick has launched an investment fund focusing on real estate, e-commerce and emerging tech. 
Does Fitbit FIT, -2.28% have something to worry about? Partner UnitedHealth UNH, -0.26% says members of its Motion plan could get paid for tracking activities on an Apple AAPL, +0.13% Watch.
